purpose: Reproducible concept-pilot thresholds for review and later joint confirmation; not an acceptance or implementation commitment.

governance.confirmation_trigger: Before any pilot launch, participating bodies and the professional team jointly confirm the version, data permissions, owners and exits, then disclose the record.
governance.privacy_boundary: Anonymous aggregates only; no individual identity, profiling or over-surveillance; key decisions receive human review.

protocols.location_zh: 众智园AI自主创新加速区／中关村科技服务翼
protocols.location_en: Zhongzhiyuan AI Autonomous Innovation Acceleration Area / Zhongguancun Technology Service Wing
protocols.baseline: Anonymous booking ledger for 4 consecutive pre-pilot weeks in the same opening hours, paired by weekday.
protocols.sample: At least 30 eligible booked groups in baseline and at least 30 in pilot.
protocols.formula: completed_visits / eligible_bookings; lift=(pilot_rate-baseline_rate)/baseline_rate; if baseline_rate=0, report absolute difference and do not claim relative lift.
protocols.numeric_threshold: Relative lift >= 10% and both periods sample >= 30; the 100% fact-check batch completion requirement also applies to the associated Storyboard Stop pilot.
protocols.exit: NO-GO if the threshold or fact-check fails, or if a privacy, heritage or public-safety P0 occurs; withdraw or adjust the route, disclose the reason and rebaseline.

protocols.baseline: The same anonymous 1-5 questionnaire collected for 4 consecutive pre-pilot weeks in the same time window.
protocols.sample: At least 30 valid baseline questionnaires and 30 valid pilot questionnaires; target validity rate >= 80%.
protocols.formula: pilot_mean - baseline_mean for the item 'the signs support staying/understanding the community'.
protocols.numeric_threshold: Mean difference >= 0.20 points and validity rate >= 80%.
protocols.owner: Community council / volunteer alliance (lead) + university evaluator (collaborate).
protocols.exit: No next phase if below threshold; publish the reason, redesign and collect a new baseline.

protocols.location_zh: 大钟寺AI产业聚集区／小月河场景赋能翼
protocols.location_en: Dazhongsi AI Industry Cluster / Xiaoyue River Scenario Empowerment Wing
protocols.baseline: Anonymous maintenance ledger and energy records for 4 consecutive pre-pilot weeks.
protocols.sample: At least 50 eligible work orders or service requests in the pilot window; no identity fields retained.
protocols.window: 8 pilot weeks with a rolling 2-week review.
protocols.numeric_threshold: 24-hour closure rate >= 90% and false-alarm rate <= 5%; associated inspection subtest uses the same >=50-work-order sample.
protocols.owner: Dazhongsi park operations team (lead) + merchant co-governance group and district agencies (collaborate).
protocols.exit: Stop, remove and disclose if either threshold is missed for 2 consecutive weeks, re-identification risk appears or human review is absent.

go_no_go.baseline: Use the baseline defined by T1, T2 and T3; no protocol is scored without its baseline window.
go_no_go.sample: T1: >=30 eligible groups in each period; T2: >=30 valid questionnaires in each period and >=80% validity; T3: >=50 eligible work orders.
go_no_go.window: After T1 4 pilot weeks, T2 4 pilot weeks and T3 8 pilot weeks, with the stated rolling reviews.
go_no_go.numeric_threshold: 3/3 passed and zero privacy, heritage, accessibility or transport-safety P0.
go_no_go.owner: Temporary review group formed by participating bodies; final confirmation by the professional team.
go_no_go.exit: NO-GO on any protocol failure; disclose, withdraw or redesign, correct for at least 2 weeks, then collect a new baseline before reconsideration.
